summary:
The comic tells science-fiction comic about astronauts exploring space while monitoring unusual cosmic weather conditions. They use satellites and spaceship equipment to study the situation, check radiation and fuel levels, and investigate what is happening outside their spaceship.
Science, technology, observation, and teamwork are important when facing challenges in space.
details:
Cosmic Weather Problem is a science-fiction comic that explores the challenges astronauts may face when travelling and working in outer space. It focuses on space weather, radiation, satellites, and the importance of monitoring conditions beyond Earth.

The main goal of this project is to educate and increase awareness about space weather and its possible effects on astronauts and spacecraft. Readers can learn about the importance of space weather monitoring in an interesting and creative way.

This project was created using hand-drawn comic illustrations, pencil, and paper. This creativity was used to combine science-fiction storytelling with real scientific topics related to space exploration.
